section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single cross-sectional study of 309 Portuguese women aged 18–50 who completed self-report measures. Path analysis showed that self-reassurance and body-image appreciation mediated the relationship between social safeness/acceptance and core eating/body-related psychopathology dimensions, with the model explaining 22%–51% of variance across outcomes; no study numbering (e.g., 'Study 1') or instrument details are provided in the abstract.
